preconditions.expression: all(3 <= int(line.strip()) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case input N must be an integer between 3 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == 1 + sum(1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if int(line.strip()) >= 3)
preconditions.description: The input must contain exactly T test cases, where T is the first line, followed by N values.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == N or output_line.strip() == '-1' for output_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output must either be a permutation of length N or '-1'.

postconditions.expression: all((output_line.strip() != '-1') and (set(map(int, output_line.split())) == set(range(1, N + 1))) for output_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', it must be a permutation of numbers from 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all((output_line.strip() == '-1') or all((int(P[i]) ^ int(P[i+1])) != int(P[i+2]) for i in range(N - 2)) for output_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the permutation must satisfy the condition that for all 1 ≤ i ≤ N-2, P[i] XOR P[i+1] ≠ P[i+2].
